title: Search History Privacy Policy Template - Protect User Data
metaDescription: Ready-to-use privacy policy template for search history data. Covers collection, storage, deletion, and user controls for search platforms.
description: Comprehensive privacy policy template specifically designed for platforms that collect search history data. Includes user rights, data retention, deletion procedures, and privacy controls to ensure compliance and build user trust.

sections.heading: Search Data We Collect
sections.content:
We collect and process the following types of search-related information when you use {{SERVICE_NAME}}:

• Search queries and keywords you enter
• Search results you click on or interact with
• Time and date of searches
• Device and browser information
• IP address and approximate location
• Search filters and preferences you apply

This information helps us improve our search functionality and provide more relevant results. We do not collect search data when you use private browsing modes or incognito features.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Search History
sections.content:
Your search history data is used for the following purposes:

• **Improving Search Results**: Analyzing search patterns to enhance our search algorithm and provide more accurate results
• **Personalization**: Customizing search suggestions and results based on your search history
• **Analytics**: Understanding user behavior to improve our services
• **Security**: Detecting and preventing spam, fraud, and abuse

We do not sell your search history to third parties. We may share aggregated, anonymized search data for research purposes, but this data cannot be traced back to individual users.

sections.heading: Search History Retention and Auto-Delete
sections.content:
We automatically delete your search history according to the following schedule:

• **Default Retention**: Search history is kept for {{RETENTION_PERIOD}} months
• **Auto-Delete Options**: You can set your search history to auto-delete after 3, 18, or 36 months
• **Manual Deletion**: You can delete individual searches or your entire search history at any time
• **Account Deletion**: All search history is permanently deleted within {{DELETION_TIMEFRAME}} days of account closure

Deleted search history cannot be recovered. We recommend using tools like a privacy-focused browser for searches you don't want stored.

sections.heading: Your Search Privacy Controls
sections.content:
You have complete control over your search history and privacy settings:

**Search History Management:**
• View your complete search history in your account settings
• Delete individual searches or entire search history
• Download a copy of your search data
• Set up automatic deletion schedules

**Privacy Settings:**
• Turn off search history collection entirely
• Enable private search mode by default
• Control personalized search results
• Manage search-based ad preferences

**Search Activity Controls:**
• Pause search history saving
• Delete search activity by date range
• Turn off location-based search improvements

sections.heading: Search Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content:
We are committed to protecting your search privacy:

**We Do Not:**
• Sell your search history to advertisers or data brokers
• Share individual search queries with third parties
• Allow external access to your personal search data

**Limited Sharing:**
• Anonymized, aggregated search trends for research purposes
• Compliance with legal requests and court orders
• Essential service providers under strict privacy agreements

**Advertising:**
We may use general search categories (not specific queries) to show relevant ads. You can opt out of personalized advertising based on search activity in your privacy settings.

sections.heading: International Search Data Transfers
sections.content:
{{SERVICE_NAME}} operates globally, and your search data may be processed in countries other than your own:

• We maintain the same privacy protections regardless of where data is processed
• Data transfers comply with applicable privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
• We use appropriate safeguards like Standard Contractual Clauses
• You can request information about where your search data is stored

For users in the EU, we ensure adequate protection for search data transferred outside the European Economic Area.

sections.heading: Contact Us About Search Privacy
sections.content:
If you have questions about your search history privacy or want to exercise your rights:

**Contact Information:**
Email: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
Mailing Address: {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}
Privacy Officer: {{PRIVACY_OFFICER}}

**Your Rights Include:**
• Requesting access to your search history data
• Correcting inaccurate search-related information
• Deleting your search history
• Objecting to certain uses of your search data
• Filing complaints with data protection authorities

We will respond to privacy requests within {{RESPONSE_TIME}} business days.
